title: EventLifecycleEvents
description: Events service lifecycle domain events (v1), carried in the platform event envelope 'data' field. Published AFTER the primary write commits, so a publish failure never fails a committed write. Consumers must be idempotent on the envelope id. `EventCreated` carries the 'also post an announcement' intent (US-2.1) rather than Events calling Announcements synchronously — that keeps event creation independent of another service's availability.

EventCreated.description: A single event or a recurring series was published. Consumed by Announcements (Unit 9) when `announce` is true, and by Analytics.

seriesId.description: Present instead of eventId for a series create

EventUpdated.description: Event details changed, or an auditable sub-resource action occurred (upload-link create/revoke, material quarantine). `notifyRsvps` tells Notifications to send an updated invite.

icsSequence.description: Must increase per change or calendar clients ignore the update
